arxiv-2108-12968.title: Kinetic construction of the high-beta anisotropic-pressure equilibrium in the magnetosphere
arxiv-2108-12968.creator: H. Aibara, Z. Yoshida, K. Shirahata
arxiv-2108-12968.description: Abstract A theoretical model of the high-beta equilibrium of magnetospheric plasma was constructed by consistently connecting the (anisotropic pressure) Grad–Shafranov equation and the Vlasov equation. The Grad–Shafranov equation was used to determine the axisymmetric magnetic field for a given magnetization current corresponding to a pressure tensor.

arxiv-2202-10992.title: Resampling-free bootstrap inference for quantiles Acknowledgement: The authors gratefully acknowledge help and feedback from Anton Muratov, Shaobo Jin, Thommy Perlinger and Claire Detilleux.
arxiv-2202-10992.creator: Mårten Schultzberg, Sebastian Ankargren
arxiv-2202-10992.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mårten Schultzberg, Sebastian Ankargren. Bootstrap inference is a powerful tool for obtaining robust inference for quantiles and difference-in-quantiles estimators. The computationally intensive nature of bootstrap inference has made it infeasible in large-scale experiments. In this paper, the theoretical properties of the Poisson bootstrap algorithm and quantile estimators are used to derive alternative resampling-free algorithms for Poisson bootstrap inference that reduce the computational complexity substantially without additional assumptions. These findings are connected to existing literature on analytical confidence intervals for quantiles based on order statistics.

arxiv-2209-14388.title: A numerical recipe for the computation of stationary stochastic processes’ autocorrelation function
arxiv-2209-14388.creator: S. Miccichè
arxiv-2209-14388.description: Abstract Many natural phenomena exhibit a stochastic nature that one attempts at modeling by using stochastic processes of different types. In this context, often one is interested in investigating the memory properties of the natural phenomenon at hand. This is usually accomplished by computing the autocorrelation function of the numerical series describing the considered phenomenon.

arxiv-2210-05087.title: Approximation of Nearly-Periodic Symplectic Maps via Structure-Preserving Neural Networks
arxiv-2210-05087.creator: Valentin Duruisseaux, Joshua W. Burby, Qi Tang
arxiv-2210-05087.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Valentin Duruisseaux, Joshua W. Burby, Qi Tang. A continuous-time dynamical system with parameter ε \varepsilon is nearly-periodic if all its trajectories are periodic with nowhere-vanishing angular frequency as ε \varepsilon approaches 0. Nearly-periodic maps are discrete-time analogues of nearly-periodic systems, defined as parameter-dependent diffeomorphisms that limit to rotations along a circle action, and they admit formal U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) symmetries to all orders when the limiting rotation is non-resonant.
